name: TR-300 Machine Report
install: if [ -f qube-machine-report/.cursor/install.sh ]; then bash qube-machine-report/.cursor/install.sh; elif [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/install.sh; else echo 'TR-300 install.sh not found' >&2; exit 1; fi

terminals.name: homepage-dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the sibling marketing homepage on http://127.0.0.1:5173/. Idles with a message when the homepage repo is not checked out.
terminals.command: HP=""; for c in qube-machine-report-homepage ../qube-machine-report-homepage; do if [ -f "$c/package.json" ]; then HP="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$HP" ]; then cd "$HP" && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173; else echo '[homepage-dev] qube-machine-report-homepage not checked out; nothing to serve.'; fi
